title: Quiz landing for home renovation
lead: A five-step quiz that ends with an approximate price and a quote form, to turn ad clicks into leads.

hero.caption: Northline Renovation: a 5-question quiz that prices the renovation on screen, with a running summary and a 2-year warranty.
hero.alt: Northline Renovation: a 5-question quiz that prices the renovation on screen, with a running summary and a 2-year warranty.

problem: A renovation crew needs a 5-step quiz (property type, area, type of work, timing, budget), an approximate price at the end and a get-a-quote form, plus blocks for the warranty, the four stages of work and finished projects.
built: Five screens with progress and a live Your renovation summary.
A transparent estimate by formula (area x price per m2, plus or minus 10%).
A form that carries all the answers.
Blocks: a 2-year warranty, 4 stages of work, finished projects.
steps: The visitor answers five short questions.
A live summary shows what they have chosen.
An approximate price appears, with its formula.
A quote form carries all the answers to you.
offer: A quiz landing built around your own questions and price formula.
Leads sent to your Telegram, email or CRM (part of a real order).
not_included: Hosting, domain and third-party service fees.
